classes.title: Lesson 1: Anatomy of Global Forex Markets & Broker Selection
classes.description: Learn how the $7.5 Trillion daily currency market operates, how tier-1 liquidity providers quote prices, and how to choose a reliable ECN broker without conflict of interest.

classes.title: Lesson 2: Calculating Pips, Lot Sizes, Leverage & True Margin
classes.description: Stop blowing accounts on bad sizing. Master the mathematical calculation of standard, mini, and micro lots, pip value across major/minor pairs, and real margin utilization.

classes.title: Lesson 3: The 4 Global Trading Sessions & High-Volume Overlaps
classes.description: When to enter and when to stay in cash. Detailed breakdown of Sydney, Tokyo, London, and New York sessions, plus the golden London-New York overlap.

classes.title: Lesson 4: Price Action & High-Probability Candlestick Patterns
classes.description: Read the raw chart without lagging indicators. Learn bullish & bearish engulfing wicks, pin bars at institutional levels, rejection candles, and momentum continuation.

classes.title: Lesson 5: Institutional Market Structure, Order Blocks & FVG
classes.description: Understand how market makers manipulate liquidity. Identifying institutional Order Blocks (OB), Fair Value Gaps (FVG), Break of Structure (BOS), and Change of Character (CHoCH).

classes.title: Lesson 6: High Liquidity Sweeps, Asian Range Raids & Inducements
classes.description: Why your stop loss gets hit right before the market moves your way. How to identify liquidity pools above equal highs and below equal lows, and trade the institutional sweep.

classes.title: Lesson 7: The Ironclad 1% Rule & 1:3 Risk-to-Reward Blueprints
classes.description: The mathematical edge that guarantees survival and long-term compounding. Even with a 40% win rate, why strict 1:3 risk-to-reward creates consistently profitable traders.

classes.title: Lesson 8: Mastering Psychology: Eliminating FOMO, Revenge Trading & Greed
classes.description: Trading is 80% psychology and 20% technicals. Developing cognitive stamina, embracing losses as operational expenses, and following an unshakeable trade routine.

classes.title: Lesson 9: Complete Trading Plan, Execution Journal & Live Checklist
classes.description: Putting it all together. The pre-market routine, economic calendar risk filter, live trade checklist, and the step-by-step spreadsheet journaling process to track your edge.

classes.title: Lesson 10: Live London Breakout Strategy
classes.description: Institutional forex class covering actionable trading setups.
